commitResults.messageTitle: Updated AGENTS.md with user setup details
Level-0: renamed chatbot to Echo, added greeting and exit, and updated Java setup instructions.

Level-1: Updated the code to echo commands entered by the user, and exit when the user types the command bye. Likewise, I created two private methods: printGreeting and printMessage for a cleaner code, and added Javadocs for them.
Level-2: Added the ability to store whatever text the user enters and display it back when requested.
Level-3: add mark/unmark commands and a Task class (A-Classes)
A-Coding standard: follow the seedu Java coding standard
Created three subclasses that extend Task class, and fixed Echo.java to show the correct output
A-CodeQuality: extract command dispatch out of main
commitResults.messageBody:
main() greets the user, runs the input loop, dispatches every command,
and prints the farewell. The dispatch chain sits at a lower level of
abstraction than the rest of main -- string slicing and Integer.parseInt
next to calls like printGreeting().

This breaks the Single Level of Abstraction Principle and makes main
harder to read as a summary of what the program does.

Let's move the if/else-if command chain into a private handleCommand
method. main() now reads as: greet, loop over input lines dispatching
each, then say goodbye. Behaviour is unchanged.

commitResults.messageTitle: Level-5: report invalid input instead of crashing
commitResults.messageBody:
Blank todo/deadline/event descriptions, malformed deadline/event syntax
(missing /by, /from, /to), non-numeric or out-of-range mark/unmark
indices, and unrecognized commands all threw uncaught exceptions
(NumberFormatException, ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException) or silently
produced wrong tasks.

Let's add EchoException and validate each command's arguments before
acting on them, catching EchoException once in main and reporting it as
"OOPS!!! <reason>". A-Exceptions extension: every current command now
has specific, user-facing error messages rather than a generic failure.

commitResults.messageTitle: A-Packages: move all classes into the echo package
commitResults.messageBody:
All six classes sit directly under src/main/java with no package,
which the coding standard's "put every class in a package" rule flags
and which the course's A-Packages increment asks to fix.

Let's put Echo, EchoException, Task, Todo, Deadline and Event into a
single package, echo, keeping src/main/java as the source root. Six
classes -- one app class, one exception, a four-class task hierarchy --
don't yet have a natural multi-package split; that becomes worthwhile
once Echo itself is broken into Ui/Parser/Storage/TaskList in a later
increment. Update the README's file path and run instructions to match.
